mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand for new homes, signaling strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises, or the correlation between HOUST and SPX 20-day returns is negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates extreme monetary easing, compressing risk-free rates and boosting equity valuations, which typically produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals labor market deterioration and manufacturing contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE and INDPRO decline, or the joint signal has a negative Rank IC over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes, a rising CPIAUCSL signals persistent inflation prompting central bank tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises in high-inflation regimes, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output and economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the correlation between INDPRO and SPX 20-day returns is negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 6.0% signals a weak labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and fall in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) signals central bank response to inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates a soft landing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or the joint signal has a negative Rank IC over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising GDP (GDPC1) signals continued economic strength and corporate earnings growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 rises in late-cycle expansion, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
